subject: HPX-SCP extension registry
summary: Illustrative proposed registration of optional impact metadata for proposals.

content.change_summary: Register x.hpx.impact as an optional typed extension.
content.rationale: Allow structured impact annotations without expanding the core proposal payload.
content.compatibility: Existing records without extensions remain valid; legacy v0.1.0 fixtures are preserved.
content.rollback: Remove the example extension key from records and deregister its schema after checking references.
